Citation syntax

Use Pandoc-style citations such as [@Smith2024]. The preview formats them and builds a reference list from your BibTeX file.

Manuscript tools

Images and figures

Open or add image files to preview them inline. Keep image paths relative so the manuscript stays portable in GitHub.

GitHub workflow

Load a manuscript from a repository, edit it here, then save a commit back to that file.

Keyboard shortcuts

  • ⌘/Ctrl + S — save
  • ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + C — citation picker
